earningsCall.slides_title: First Abu Dhabi Bank Q3 2026 slides
summary: First Abu Dhabi Bank reported record Q3 2026 net profit of AED 5.74B, up 6% YoY; nine-month profit rose 3% to AED 16.46B with 18.6% return on tangible equity.
Net interest income surged 11% YoY to AED 16.98B while gross loans grew 10% to AED 697B; cost-to-income ratio held at industry-leading 21.5%.
Management reaffirmed 2026 guidance, targeting loan growth at upper end of low-to-mid teens range and NIM at 180-190 basis points with sub-70bp cost of risk.
International operations now contribute 22% of revenue; bank investing heavily in AI with 6,000+ employee-developed agents and digital asset initiatives.
Bank expects stronger 2027 growth driven by 5.8% UAE GDP expansion and infrastructure investment; CET1 ratio strengthened to 14%, above 13.5% target.
